testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand a parent folder that matches browser search ✔ Given a part with a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ When the user opens browser search and enters "origin" ✔ Then the browser shows Origin as a matching collapsed row ✔ And the Origin text is highlighted ✔ When the user expands the matching Origin row ✔ Then its plane, axis and center-point children are displayed ✔ And the child labels appear dimmed while the search remains active ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user clears the query and closes the empty search field ✔ Then the unfiltered browser tree is displayed ✔ And the Origin children are visible
